system_prompt_style.evidence_quote:
Skill metadata (name, description, location) is injected into the
system prompt.
system_prompt_style.note: The README also states that Ellama reads project instructions from AGENTS.md. The quote spans a line break in the README.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote:
This global context is
prepended to your prompt before transmission to the LLM.
env_context_strategy.note: Two mechanisms are present: user-added global context is prepended to the prompt, and the model can navigate with tools (read_file, grep, directory_tree). Tools are disabled until enabled, so the default may effectively be user-supplied context only.

context_compaction.evidence_quote:
Compaction summarizes older conversation turns into one synthetic
assistant message and keeps the most recent user turns verbatim.
context_compaction.note: Auto-compaction is enabled by default. Tool output line-budget truncation is also enabled by default (200 lines).

observation_format.evidence_quote:
~auto~: read text files as text and queue supported media files for model
input
observation_format.note: The read_file tool can queue image files as media. 'screenshots' is the closest value for image input; audio input has no matching value.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote:
Models or providers that cannot call tools can still participate by emitting the
fallback ~BEGIN_ELLAMA_AGENT_STATE~ block described in the controller prompt.
tool_call_format.note: Native tool calls go through the llm package. The BEGIN_ELLAMA_AGENT_STATE text-block fallback is mapped to xml_tags as the closest value.

tool_count.note: The evidence does not include the full tool registry. Tools are off by default until ellama-tools-enable-all is run.

edit_primitive.note: The edit_file argument shape is not shown in the evidence; search_replace is inferred.

tool_schema_source.note: MCP support requires the external mcp.el package.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: Use MCP (Model Context Protocol) tools with ~ellama~.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote:
It
starts with a planning turn, asks the model to submit a checklist, and then
continues automatically through the checklist
loop_primitives.note: The default mode is chat with tool calls. plan-and-act is a separate command.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: ~agent_submit_plan~ records the initial checklist before acting starts
planning_granularity.note: The plan object is used in ellama-plan-and-act mode.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Ellama provides two tools for delegating work to an asynchronous sub-agent.
multi_agent_topology.note: The task tool makes orchestrator_workers reachable once tools are enabled.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Each sub-agent runs in its own Ellama session.
delegation_mechanism.note: The default is none because tools are disabled. subagent_spawn is reachable through the task tool.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote:
~ellama-tools-allowed~: List of allowed ~ellama~ tools. Tools from this list
will work without user confirmation.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Plan-and-act state is stored in the session extra data

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Ellama scans skill directories when each chat starts.

state_persistence.evidence_quote:
Chat sessions can be saved,
resumed, renamed, compacted manually

self_verification.evidence_quote:
Before hooks run after access checks and syntax validation, but before the file
is written.
self_verification.note: Edit hooks are configurable and can run linters or tests. llm_judge corresponds to the optional DLP LLM safety classifier, which is a safety check rather than a correctness check. test_execution is reachable through hooks such as 'make test'.

retry_policy.evidence_quote:
If the LLM request fails before the loop receives a usable response, Ellama
continues the same agent loop instead of stopping it.
retry_policy.note: The quoted behaviour is step-level error recovery, not a task-level retry.

rollback.evidence_quote:
failure is reported to the agent and does not roll back the
edit.
rollback.note: ellama-undo-on-error undoes partial buffer insertions only.

termination_condition.evidence_quote:
until the agent reports a result,
marks the plan complete, becomes blocked, or reaches
~ellama-tools-agent-default-max-steps~.

cost_controls.note: Per-task provider selection is the closest match to model_routing. ellama-max-tokens limits output tokens only.

timeouts.evidence_quote:
~ellama-tools-shell-command-default-timeout~: Default timeout for shell
command execution.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote:
~ellama-tools-use-srt~: Run shell-based tools (~shell_command~, ~grep~ and
~grep_in_file~) via the external ~srt~ sandbox runtime. Disabled by default.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote:
Disabled by default.
If enabled, non-shell file tools also perform local filesystem checks
filesystem_access.note: Access becomes scoped when srt is enabled.

network_policy.evidence_quote:
Local checks intentionally ignore unrelated ~srt~ keys (for example
~network.*~).
network_policy.note: An srt network allowlist is reachable when srt is enabled.

permission_model.evidence_quote:
Tools from this list
will work without user confirmation.
permission_model.note: A DLP and irreversible-action policy engine is reachable through configuration.

tracing.evidence_quote:
~ellama-tools-dlp-audit-log-file~: JSONL path used when ~file~ sink is
enabled.

replayability.note: The evidence does not cover the replay code.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: ~ellama-eval-default-max-steps~: Default maximum number of steps in eval loop.

guardrails.note: DLP is optional and disabled unless configured, for example through ellama-setup-agentic-coding.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Work with local and cloud LLMs from Emacs.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: Ellama is not tied to one backend.
